Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Cody Laux <cody@scs.unr.edu> wrote:
>	1. Can you transfer equipment from a vampire in torpor to a 
>vampire not in torpor?

Your minions can grab equipment from your torpored vampires
via the equip action, yes.

>	2. Can you use cards such as fast hands at long range?

It doesn't say it's usable at long range, so no.

>	3. Does a vampire go to torpor immediatly after going below zero 
>or receiving aggravated damage, or does it have time to do additional 
>strikes and stuff?

Immediately.

Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
Cody Laux (cody@scs.unr.edu) wrote:
: 	1. Can you transfer equipment from a vampire in torpor to a 
: vampire not in torpor?

Yes you can.  (Corrected rules 12.3.1, Equip minion).  The minion doing 
the taking is the acting minion (the one who is tapped).  Any number of 
equipment can be transfered that way in a single action.  If blocvked, no 
transfer occured.  It is done at +1 Stealth.

: 	2. Can you use cards such as fast hands at long range?

Corrected rules, 15.3 Steal Equipment: @This effect is like destroy 
equipment, except...@
Corrected rules, 15.3 Destroy Equipment: @This cannot be done at long 
range unless specified by the card.@

: 	3. Does a vampire go to torpor immediatly after going below zero 
: or receiving aggravated damage, or does it have time to do additional 
: strikes and stuff?

It goes right away, straight to the torpor area.  If it suffered enough 
damage to be burnd, it goes straight to the Ash Heap (don't pass go, 
don't collect 200$ stuff. :).

Messages.Author: Andre Kostur
Messages.Body:
cody@scs.unr.edu (Cody Laux) writes:

>	1. Can you transfer equipment from a vampire in torpor to a 
>vampire not in torpor?
Yep.

>	2. Can you use cards such as fast hands at long range?
Don't recognize the card... but if it refers to hand damage, then no.

>	3. Does a vampire go to torpor immediatly after going below zero 
>or receiving aggravated damage, or does it have time to do additional 
>strikes and stuff?
I believe the combat sequence is Manuvers, Declare Strike, Resolve
Strike, Press.  I think you check for torpor right after the Resolve
Strike part (before Additional Strikes).  Note that damage prevention
is allowed...
